caption: A wooden skewer is dropped into the grill's coals and catches fire.

sa.check: A wooden skewer is dropped into a grill's coals.
The skewer catches fire where it touches the coals.
The flame runs along the skewer.
The skewer blackens and shrinks behind the flame.
The skewer is pale wood before it catches.
The drop comes first and the catching follows.

pc.expect: The flame only advances along the skewer from where it caught, and the blackened part stays black.
pc.fail: A blackened part of the skewer turns back to pale wood; or the flame front retreats leaving unburnt wood behind it; or the skewer catches at a point no coal touched; or the skewer grows longer as it burns.

pc.expect: The skewer shrinks to ash rather than vanishing at a stroke, and the coals keep their number.
pc.fail: The skewer vanishes in a single frame while still long; or a second skewer appears; or a coal vanishes leaving no ash; or the skewer passes through the grate and out below whole.

pc.expect: The flame points upward from the skewer, the skewer rests on the coals, and ash settles down.
pc.fail: The flame points downward under the skewer; or the skewer lifts off the coals and hangs in the air; or the ash rises and stays aloft; or the flame hangs below the coals.

pc.expect: The skewer catches where it touches the coals and the wood there chars first.
pc.fail: The skewer catches at its far end away from the coals; or the skewer lies on glowing coals and stays pale and unmarked to the end of the clip; or the flame appears in the air beside the skewer with a gap to the wood.

pc.expect: The skewer stays a straight stick as it chars and the coals stay lumps; nothing turns into anything else.
pc.fail: The skewer melts and drips; or the skewer turns into another object; or the coals merge into one smooth mass; or the skewer bends into a ring.

pc.expect: The grate, the coals' bed and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The grate changes spacing; or the coals rearrange away from the skewer; or the background changes between frames.
